title: evidence-gated residual action -- KEEP mechanism / HONEST NEGATIVE on deployed gain (deployable conversion gap)
source_commit_cited: eb26b90 (R5: the R4 signal IS locally learnable)
decision: KEEP the mechanism (correct + safe + suppression value); HONEST NEGATIVE on the deployed feasibility/return gain -- B == anchor at best, every firing threshold net-negative in mean, no threshold beats the anchor.

evidence_gate.net_effect_vs_anchor: == anchor at tau_edit 0.5 (best); net-negative when firing edits

edit_head/repair_head/safety_head.role: gate signal (frozen R5 heads, local features)

deployable.csi_scope: current-frame channel (stale overlay off, as R5); stale-overlay-on full pilot is R8

threshold_sweep.finding: downhill from the empty gate: best operating point is the empty gate (tau_edit 0.5, B==anchor); every firing threshold is net-negative IN MEAN and raises unsafe_edit (curve is drop-then-partial-recovery, not strictly monotone; each per-tau B-A CI spans 0, so the load-bearing claim is no-tau-lower-bound>0, not per-tau significance).

interpretation: The gate mechanism is correct/safe/load-bearing and the R5 ranking is real, but the ranking's ~40% top-k precision does not convert into a net deployed gain: at every operating point the gate either does nothing (B==anchor) or fires net-harmful edits (a harmful edit's feasibility cost exceeds a beneficial edit's gain). Deployable CONVERSION gap -- distinct from R5's learnability positive (significant on random; strong-mean-but-not-significant on urban). Trained heads' only deployable value = safe suppression (B > random-gate C in mean, not 95%-sig).
diagnosis_scope: DATA/precision limit at the observation+evaluation scope; NOT a mechanism/path/trainer/leak bug. Binding limit sharpened: deployable PRECISION of the beneficial-edit direction signal, not its existence (R4) or learnability (R5).
effect_on_decision: gate changes final topology (edit_rate 0.001 at tau0.5 -> up to 0.11 at tau0.05); trained-head effect net-neutral (==anchor), random-gate effect net-harmful (C<A); load-bearing on the action.

adversarial_verification.independent_checks: leak-free grep (only evaluator token = static .scene budgets); budget-safe degree-count under aggressive head; zero-gated->anchor with tau=2.0; hand-recomputed gate matches module gated_add/gated_remove exactly; trained-vs-untrained gate differ (B depends on training); train/held seed-disjoint, held never in loss; every CI reconstructs from t=2.776/n=5.
adversarial_verification.minor_fixes_applied: (1) 'monotone downhill' -> 'downhill from the empty gate; every firing threshold net-negative in mean; no tau lo>0' (curve is drop-then-partial-recovery, per-tau CIs span 0); (2) 'R5 learnability positive' hedged (significant random, strong-mean-not-sig urban); (3) 'edit_rate ~0.001' noted as 5-seed mean (per-seed ~0.006).
